location: skills/shared/scripts/render-voter-prompt.sh (planned output in plan.txt:15-36); scripts/test-render-voter-prompt.sh (planned assertions in plan.txt:43-46); scripts/dispatch-code-voters.sh:51-69; skills/review/scripts/collect-findings.sh:412-420; scripts/lib-vote-tally.sh:8-29
what: The proposed unified OOS clause is not grammar-parameterized: finding-only /review voters would still receive "or OOS_N: items in plan review" even though /review ballots serialize OOS as FINDING_N headings with [OUT_OF_SCOPE], and vote parsing matches only the exact ballot id.
scenario_or_breakage: The plan's --id-grammar finding-only suppresses only OOS_N example lines, not the OOS_N parenthetical in the canonical clause; a /review voter handling a FINDING_7 [OUT_OF_SCOPE] ballot item can be nudged toward emitting OOS_7, which vote_for_id will not match for FINDING_7 and will count as JUDGE_ERROR. The planned finding-only test asserts the OOS clause is present and OOS_N examples are absent, but it does not assert grammar-irrelevant OOS_N prose is absent.
suggested_fix: Make the OOS clause text conditional on --id-grammar: finding-only should say only "For items prefixed with [OUT_OF_SCOPE]"; finding-oos should mention OOS_N plan-review items. Add a finding-only harness assertion that the rendered prompt contains no "OOS_N" substring except where intentionally impossible, and keep the shared doc/SKILL copies aligned with the grammar-specific runtime wording.
